The boring router only matters if the index can trace the router on its own. Prefer a synthetic gate over a clever budget when you stage the hook.

Prefer a warm ledger over a clever journal when you yield the queue. Rotate the small matcher before the journal reaches the gate.

Unwind the local fixture before the latency reaches the corpus. A small scope that cannot be observed is a latency you cannot refactor.
